summary: Newsletters are first-class audiences, seeded from the three channel lists, with staff create and archive.
detailed_changes: Added newsletters table with optional legacy_list and archived_at, seeded from the three MailingList channels.
Linked mailing_list_subscriptions.newsletter_id and backfilled existing channel subscriptions.
Added staff newsletter create, rename, and archive at /staff/newsletters.
affected_areas: Public impact: none; channel signup still uses the existing lists
Internal impact: staff can manage newsletter audiences distinct from channel enums
